title: Co-Registered Optical (Sentinel-2) + SAR (Sentinel-1) Cross-Modal Sample Pack
source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 GRD & Sentinel-2 L2A Co-Registered Missions
license: Open Data / CC BY 4.0 / Copernicus Open Access

samples.name: Coastal Harbor & Maritime Industrial Terminal
samples.sar_sensor: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR (Level-1 GRD Backscatter Intensity)
samples.alignment_info: Rigid pixel-to-pixel co-registration on standard 10m UTM grid

cross_modal_cues.water_detection: Optical high blue / low NIR response ∩ SAR low specular backscatter (calm water reflection away from sensor)
cross_modal_cues.built_up_detection: Optical neutral gray / structural reflectance ∩ SAR high double-bounce metallic/concrete backscatter

samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/optical-sar -F "optical_file=@samples/optical_sar/pair1_coastal_port_sentinel2_optical.png" -F "sar_file=@samples/optical_sar/pair1_coastal_port_sentinel1_sar.png" -F "query=Identify water and built-up areas."

samples.name: River Basin & Agricultural Floodplain
samples.sar_sensor: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR (Level-1 GRD Backscatter Intensity)

cross_modal_cues.water_detection: Meandering river channel exhibiting low SAR backscatter and dominant blue spectral absorption
cross_modal_cues.built_up_detection: Farm homesteads and rural road junctions with localized high radar double-bounce

samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/optical-sar -F "optical_file=@samples/optical_sar/pair2_river_farmland_sentinel2_optical.png" -F "sar_file=@samples/optical_sar/pair2_river_farmland_sentinel1_sar.png" -F "query=Highlight river channel and settlements."
